sources.games: 1074 league games since 7.41 (data/heroes/item_stats), win 51.1%. Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py axe.
sources.hero: Valve /datafeed/herodata hero_id 2 (Berserker's Call, Counter Helix, Culling Blade), 7.41f.
sources.player: Player review, 2026-10-20: no Spirit Vessel for offlaners against heavy healing (a support's item); Linken's Sphere for Queen of Pain, Puck, Void Spirit and Storm Spirit against Phantom Assassin and Spirit Breaker, not Slark; Axe levels Battle Hunger second; Templar Assassin keeps Meld > Psi Blades > Refraction.

rules.name: Black King Bar
rules.basis: Valve 7.41f Black King Bar: Avatar applies a basic dispel, 60% magic resistance and makes negative effects of enemy spells do nothing for 9/8/7 s. It is in his build (71% of the won games, ~25 min); Pipe of Insight is not. Berserker's Call puts him inside the enemy team for up to 3 s.

reason.en: {enemy} and other magic damage heroes are in their team: {item} is in your build, take it earlier, so their spells cannot stop you after Berserker's Call
reason.uk: {enemy} та інші герої з магічною шкодою: {item} і так у вашій збірці — візьміть його раніше, щоб після Berserker's Call їхні здібності вас не зупинили

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute: bracer 42% (2), vanguard 33% (5), magic_wand 69% (7), phase_boots 93% (7), blade_mail 90% (12), soul_ring 35% (15), aghanims_shard 80% (23), black_king_bar 71% (25), pers 29% (26), kaya 21% (28), lotus_orb 20% (29).

tempo.basis: Gold lines where the hero wins 85.0%+: 20:00 14000 (13 games, 92.3%), 25:00 17500 (27 games, 88.9%), 30:00 20500 (29 games, 86.2%); net worth ~0.96 of that gold; points under 20 games left out.

reason.en: Your net worth is {net_worth}, well ahead for this minute: {item} on the tempo build comes before the counters, then lead the fights and take objectives with your team
reason.uk: Ваш нетворс — {net_worth}, набагато більше звичайного для цієї хвилини: спершу {item} з темпової збірки, потім ведіть бійки й беріть об'єкти разом із командою

skills.basis: The player review (2026-10-20): Battle Hunger second, the order that wins more (433 games, won 55.4%, against 550 and 48.9% with Berserker's Call second). 1074 games since 7.41: maxed axe_counter_helix > axe_berserkers_call > axe_battle_hunger 550 (win 48.9%), axe_counter_helix > axe_battle_hunger > axe_berserkers_call 433 (win 55.4%), axe_battle_hunger > axe_counter_helix > axe_berserkers_call 49 (win 69.4%); talents 10: Movement Speed per active Battle Hunger 939/1072 (52.2%), Culling Blade Kill Buff Bonus Duration 133/1072 (44.4%); 15: Battle Hunger Damage Per Second 800/1016 (56.4%), Berserker's Call Armor 216/1016 (44.0%); 20: +15 Strength 426/684 (62.2%), Counter Helix Damage 258/684 (62.0%); 25: Berserker's Call AoE 188/234 (63.8%), Culling Blade Damage 46/234 (73.9%).
